prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in League City, Texas. Injury: wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1241; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in League City, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. I had the green light and was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic when the impact happened. The collision threw me against the driver's side door, and I broke my wrist in the fall. I have described the events the same way every time I have spoken about them, to the other driver, to the responding officer, and to the medical staff who treated me. I am the named driver on this policy and I am submitting this claim for the damage to my vehicle and my medical costs related to the wrist fracture.
